ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$ where $\angle C=90^\circ$, $BC=5$, and $AC=12$, what is the value of $\tan B$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: In the right triangle $\triangle ABC$, $\angle C=90^\circ$, $BC=5$, and $AC=12$, \\
thus $\tan B=\frac{AC}{BC}=\boxed{\frac{12}{5}}$.
